coverage: Real Web Crypto round trips binary and zero-byte files, fresh encryption, wrong recipient, authenticated tampering and version downgrade rejection.

Desktop/mobile sender refuses a mismatched file; a separate recipient context restores its receiving key, decrypts, downloads exact binary bytes, makes no remote request during opening/download and clears the file preview.
